Bulk Dehydrated Basil Leaves Supplier India

Sauce makers, pizza chains, seasoning blenders and meal-kit brands use dried basil every day, and most of them want the same leaf, cut and aroma every time. Tradenest Naturals is a bulk dehydrated basil leaves supplier in India serving these food manufacturers, along with importers, distributors and private label brands. Our basil is cut to 8-16 mesh, keeps a clean herbal aroma and stores well without refrigeration. In addition, buyers can request wholesale dehydrated basil leaves in standard or customized packaging. As an experienced dehydrated basil leaves exporter and dehydrated basil leaves supplier, we focus on practical specifications and consistent batch quality. Our team reviews raw material quality, drying conditions, sieving, packing, and traceability at each stage. Therefore, customers receive a stable ingredient that supports efficient production and predictable finished-product results.

Product Overview

Dehydrated basil leaves come from carefully selected basil foliage. We clean and dry the leaves to reduce moisture while preserving their natural herbal aroma and green color. The dried leaves provide a convenient alternative to fresh basil. They also reduce preparation time, product waste, and cold-chain dependence. The product can suit foodservice and industrial applications. It works well in seasoning blends, sauces, soups, bakery products, snacks, pasta products, and ready-to-cook foods. Moreover, we can discuss cut size, pack format, labeling, and supply volume before production.

Typical Product Specifications

  • Product form: Dried basil leaves
  • Mesh or cut size: 8-16 mesh
  • Moisture content: ≤ 8%
  • Processing: Dehydrated, cleaned and sieved
  • Color: Green to deep green, depending on crop and processing
  • Ingredients: Dehydrated basil leaves only
  • Additives: None added unless specifically requested and agreed
  • Packaging: Food-grade, moisture-resistant, and export-suitable formats
These values represent typical commercial specifications. Final specifications depend on the agreed purchase specification, crop, order volume, and destination requirements. A product specification sheet is shared with every quotation.

Sourcing and Processing

Raw material is carefully selected and sourced from trusted growers. We then inspect the raw material for freshness, cleanliness, maturity, and visible defects. Next, we remove unwanted foreign matter and prepare the leaves for controlled drying. Our dehydration process reduces moisture under controlled conditions. This approach helps protect the product from rapid spoilage and supports a longer storage period. After drying, we inspect the leaves and sieve them to achieve the requested cut or mesh range. We then conduct packing in a controlled food-handling environment. In addition, batch identification supports traceability from processing through dispatch. We can review customer requirements for customized specifications, private label packaging, and export documentation. As a result, buyers receive a more coordinated supply solution from one supply partner.

Quality and Food Safety Approach

Quality begins with suitable raw material selection. We apply documented operating practices for inspection, moisture control, handling, packing, and batch management. Furthermore, we maintain product identification and quality records for order traceability. Tradenest Naturals is an FSSAI registered food business and an IEC registered exporter. A product specification sheet and batch details are shared before order confirmation. If your customer needs independent results, third-party lab testing can be arranged on request at the buyer's cost. For regulated markets, customers should share their import rules early. Our team can then review labeling, packaging and documentation needs. This step helps reduce delays and supports smoother international shipments.

Applications

Dehydrated basil leaves provide a practical herbal ingredient for commercial recipes. Their concentrated aroma supports efficient dosing in both dry and wet formulations. For example, food producers can use them in:
  • Pizza, pasta, and Italian seasoning blends
  • Tomato sauces, pasta sauces, and cooking sauces
  • Soups, gravies, marinades, and ready-to-cook meals
  • Snack seasonings, savory mixes, and flavored crackers
  • Bakery fillings, savory breads, and herb-based products
  • Restaurant, hotel, cafe, and cloud kitchen recipes
  • Private label spice and culinary herb packs
  • Meal kits, instant foods, and convenience food products
Manufacturers can blend the leaves with oregano, thyme, rosemary, parsley, garlic, onion, pepper, or other seasonings. However, the final blend should match the customer’s target flavor and label requirements. We can also discuss custom formulation and ingredient development for larger programs.

Buyer Value

  • Longer storage potential than fresh basil under suitable conditions
  • Reduced preparation labor and lower handling waste
  • Convenient supply for year-round commercial production
  • Consistent dry format for blending and dosing
  • Flexible pack sizes for distributors and manufacturers
  • Better logistics efficiency without routine refrigerated transport
  • Support for private label and export-ready packaging programs
  • Scalable supply for recurring wholesale requirements
Therefore, the product can help food businesses simplify procurement and improve production planning. Buyers can select standard bulk packs or request a packaging program based on their channel, market, and expected consumption.

Packaging and Shelf Life

We pack dehydrated basil leaves in food-grade, moisture-resistant materials. Packaging helps protect the leaves from humidity, contamination, light, and physical damage during storage and transport. Each shipment can carry essential information such as product name, batch number, net weight, manufacturing date, expiry date, storage instructions, and applicable regulatory details. Standard packaging options include 100 g, 250 g, 500 g, 1 kg, 5 kg, 10 kg, and 25 kg packs. We also offer bulk bags, stand-up pouches, PET jars, HDPE containers, export packaging, and private label packaging. Custom printed formats depend on artwork, material selection, order quantity, and production planning. Shelf life is 12 months from manufacture when the product remains sealed and stored correctly. This shelf life is stated on the product specification sheet and on the label.

Storage and Handling

Store the product in a cool, dry, and clean place. Keep the package tightly closed after opening. Protect it from direct sunlight, heat, humidity, pests, and strong odors. Use clean, dry utensils during handling. Also, avoid storing the product beside wet ingredients or steam-producing equipment. Proper storage helps preserve aroma, color, texture, and overall usability throughout the declared shelf life.

MOQ, Lead Time, and Samples

What is the minimum order quantity for bulk dehydrated basil leaves? Our MOQ is 5 Kg. It is a simple way to trial the product in your own recipes before placing a larger order. OEM and private label programs need extra time for packaging setup. Lead time depends on stock status, order quantity, packaging, documentation, and production scheduling. We share the expected dispatch date with each quotation. Custom printed packaging or third-party testing requested by the buyer may add time. We confirm the schedule before accepting the order. To request a sample or quote, share your required quantity, target mesh or cut, packaging preference, destination country, label needs, and quality requirements. Our team will then send the specification sheet and a commercial offer. Samples are available on request.

Why Work With Tradenest Naturals?

Tradenest Naturals supports buyers beyond basic product supply. We combine food ingredient sourcing, bulk packing, private label expertise, and export coordination. In addition, our team can support custom formulations, ingredient sourcing, recipe development, and packaging discussions. Our focus remains clear communication and consistent execution. We help customers compare specifications, select suitable packaging, and plan repeat supply. Above all, we aim to build long-term partnerships with importers, distributors, food brands, and industrial users.

Frequently Asked Questions

What quality documents do you provide?

Tradenest Naturals is FSSAI and IEC registered. A product specification sheet is shared with every quotation, and third-party lab testing can be arranged on request at the buyer's cost. We follow moisture control, batch traceability and inspection procedures. Please list your required import documents during inquiry.

What are the typical mesh, moisture, and shelf-life specifications?

The leaves are cut to 8-16 mesh. Moisture is ≤ 8%, and shelf life is 12 months in sealed packaging.

How can I check the dehydrated basil leaves price?

Dehydrated basil leaves price depends on quantity, crop conditions, quality, cut size, packaging, private labeling, and delivery terms. Send your requirements for a current quotation.

Can you supply dehydrated basil leaves in bulk?

Yes. We supply bulk quantities for manufacturers, exporters, wholesalers, restaurants, and distributors. Recurring programs can be planned around forecast volume and agreed specifications. Contact Tradenest Naturals today for a sample, technical discussion, or quotation for wholesale dehydrated basil leaves.
